text:
deploy-bot: Finished canary rollout: service=frontier-models tag=v2026.03.15 canary=10%
ingrid: noticing p95 -> 1.5s, p99 -> 6.1s on /v1/generate since the canary went live
sam-oncall: seeing spike in 504s and gateway timeouts in prod-alerts, %5xx up from 0.3% to 4.6% last 5m
leo: confirming traces show request queuing at the inference gateway, tail latencies from canary pods are huge
ingrid: this lines up with the new kernel-prefetch flag in v2026.03.15, possible regressions in kv cache warmup
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: P99 latency > 5s and 5xx > 2% for /v1/generate — paging sam-oncall
ops: sam-oncall are you taking? we should decide rollback vs. scale
sam-oncall: I'm on it. quick triage: are errors coming from canary only or global?
leo: traffic split is 90/10; metrics show errors concentrated on canary instances (10% hosts) but traces show gateway connection resets upstream
maria: customer-impact dashboard shows a handful of enterprise tenants with increased errors (IDs: cust-221, cust-987), not yet widespread but affecting chat flows
ingrid: canary logs show repeated `KVCacheWarmupTimeout` and `evict loop` entries
sam-oncall: let's start mitigation: 1) pause canary promotion and shift canary traffic to stable, 2) if errors persist, rollback canary to previous tag, 3) notify CS for affected customers
leo: pausing promotion: `redwood deploy pause --service frontier-models --tag v2026.03.15` -> done
sam-oncall: redirecting traffic: `routectl set-weights frontier-models stable=100 canary=0 --dry-run` then apply -> applied
ops: confirming weights now stable=100, canary=0, load balancing re-evaluating connections
ingrid: tail logs show transient improvement — p95 down to 300ms, p99 still ~2.2s (some orphaned canary pods draining)
sam-oncall: starting canary rollback to v2026.02.28 on canary pods: `redwood deploy rollback --service frontier-models --to-tag v2026.02.28 --scope canary`
incident-bot: Rollback initiated by sam-oncall at 2155554390 — watch jobs: https://deploys.redwood/internal/rollbacks/2155554390
maria: CS loop started, pinged cust-221 and cust-987: letting them know we're investigating intermittent timeouts, advising retry/backoff
leo: rollback completed, canary pods replaced, KV warmup logs no longer printing the timeout error on new pods
sam-oncall: metrics update: p95=180ms, p99=420ms, 5xx back to baseline 0.4% in last 3m
ops: any follow-up mitigation? increase preload/cache size to avoid warmup on next deploy?
ingrid: yes, we should add a short prewarm hook for KV cache and disable kernel-prefetch flag until we validate on staging. Filing a model-onboarding ticket
sre-handoff: taking post-mortem + long-running investigation. I'll collect traces and correlating deploy diffs. assigning owners: ingrid (root cause), leo (observability), maria (customer comms)
sam-oncall: handing off to SRE for ongoing work. If anything spikes again I'll re-pager. Thanks all :thumbsup:
